name: Galactic Love Utopia
source:
After being taken by aliens, you wake up in some kind of futuristic medbay. There's no scary experiments on this alien base though, as it is filled with sexy alien women ready for you to seduce them! Maybe being kidnapped by aliens isn't quite as bad as the movies make it seem?

[From [url=https://twitter.com/Kaijoseisoft/status/1730551276755120224]Xitter[/url]]
translation:
被外星人带走后，你在某种未来派医疗湾中醒来。不过，这个外星基地并没有什么可怕的实验，因为里面到处都是性感的外星女性，随时等待着你去引诱她们！也许被外星人绑架并不像电影中描述的那么糟糕？

[来自[url=https://twitter.com/Kaijoseisoft/status/1730551276755120224]Xitter[/url]]
